post.description: Searches app recommendations for the specified customer using the filtering, sorting, and pagination criteria in the request body (filterBy, sortBy, pageBy). The response is a paginated list with totalPages, totalCount, page, and pageSize.
post.operationId: App Recommendation Resource Get All App Recommendations

schema.description: Defines the request body for search calls, containing sortBy, filterBy and pageBy. It is used by the microtenants search and application recommendation search calls.

items.description: Defines a single filter condition used in list queries. It contains the filterName, operator, and values to match.
items.title: UIFilter

pageBy.description: Defines the paging parameters used in filter and sort requests. Contains page and pageSize along with the validated values validPage and validPageSize.
pageBy.title: Pagination

sortBy.description: Defines a sort option for a filter request. Contains sortName and sortOrder.
sortBy.title: Sort

schema.title: FilterAndSort

requestBody.description: The body type of the operation request or response.

schema.description: Represents a paginated response containing a list of AppRecommendation objects, along with paging fields such as totalPages and totalCount.

items.description: Represents an application recommendation, including its name, overallScore, transactions and port ranges. It is returned as an entry in application recommendation lists.
Represents a domain included in an application recommendation. Contains fields such as name, applicationId and confidenceScore.
items.title: RecommendedDomain

items.description: Contains a reason for an application recommendation, described by reasonCode and its related parameter lists. It is part of the AppRecommendation object.
items.title: AppRecommendationReason

items.description: Represents a user group observed in an application recommendation. Contains fields such as groupName, usersCount and groupingType.
items.title: RecommendationObservedUserGroup

items.description: Represents the mapping between a recommendation and a recommended user group. Contains fields such as recommendationId, recommendedUserGroupId, groupingType and isExisting.
items.title: RecommendedAppSegmentUserGroupMapping

items.description: Represents a domain pattern included in an application recommendation. Contains fields such as pattern and coverage.
items.title: RecommendedDomainPattern

items.description: Represents a Server Group included in an application recommendation. Contains fields such as name, enabled, configSpace and learningEnabled.
Represents a group of connectors, identified by name, with enabled, description and location. It is referenced by the RecommendedServerGroup object.
items.title: AssistantGroup

extranetEnabled.description: Applicable only for ServerGroup endpoints not applicable for PolicySet/PolicyRule endpoints

items.description: Represents an application server, identified by name and enabled, with an address. It is used to create and retrieve servers and appears in Server Group objects.
items.title: ApplicationServer

description.content: The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.
Specifies the page number.

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.
(Required) The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.
